entry_state: The loss component is tracked within liability, not added again. Financing changes CSM release and revenue timing even with unchanged claims. Two differently profitable issued groups and their separate reinsurance now share one company balance sheet.
exit_state: The declared proportional loss allocation includes finance as well as service. Reinsurance tracks the covered component within its asset without a second CSM reversal. The connected year-one balances reconcile to equity 83; final settlement is next.
findings: With alpha 3/13, group B's year-one financing adds 36/13 to its loss component and service reverses 213/13.
Reinsurance component reversal changes service presentation rather than its total; cash 173 plus asset 46.5 less liabilities 65.5 and 71 equals equity 83. No new defect observed.
